summary: Promotional-Celestial pass: reviewed the 38 unwired Emperor-pool cards from the set. Wired 24 (Masatane, Tashiki, Miya Masatsuko, Yotsu Ueda, Kamalakar, Jahan; A Brave New World, Folklore, Fukurokujin's Wisdom, Gaining Experience, Economic Manipulation; Blue Tanuki Bar, Recruitment Officer (+ created Fresh Recruit), The Imperial Treasury, Deadlands, The Ivory Coast, War-ravaged Plain, Fudo Cultist, Yotsu Ueda's Chosen; All Within the World, Channeling the Fallen, Hunger of the Fire, Inexpensive Armor, Colonist's Mark) as four feature-owned waves. 14 are blocked and recorded in build_card_inventory BLOCKERS; two stale blockers removed. The other 129 entries of the set are outside the Emperor deck pool/inventory (112 untyped Destroyer War-era cards and deckbackers, 17 typed and already wired). Shared one-line edits: GoldQuotes, MatchEngine, MatchQueries, CardAbilities, AbilityCosts (Region DiscardFromPlay now clears RegionId), TargetedActionReactions, BattleAbsentMovesTests. New catalogue art pack catalogue-art-promo-celestial-20261005-r1 (4047 images).
validation: Merged-tree Core suite 2419 PASS 0 FAIL; tools/content unittest passes except the art-pack coverage test, which passes after the pack rebuild (test_catalogue_art 8/8, ensure_catalogue_art --archive and --verify-only OK). Client not run.
remaining: Blocked cards listed in BLOCKERS (Hyobuko, Masaya, Natsu-Togumara's Guidance, Benten's Blessing, Green Nightshade Blend, Lying in Ambush, Minor Blackmail, Near Miss, Open Recruitment, Shrine to the Heavens, Stone of Remembrance, Magistrate's Stipend, Coin Pouch, Wyrmbone Katana). Readings taken but not rulings: Kamalakar negates the whole action; Jahan bars Terrains incl. via abilities; Hunger of the Fire uses the greater of Force/Chi and current Force; Fudo Cultist/Yotsu Ueda's Chosen are attach discounts only; Deadlands refills from the discard pile incl. dead; All Within the World offers every qualifying own Ring; Miya Masatsuko printed text has no Favor keyword. Client and exported game not run.
